Add filter-sterilized ethanol and vitamin solutions and autoclaved Na2S·9H2O and cysteine-HCl solutions.
Use a 10-20% inoculum.
For the trace element solution, first dissolve NTA in 200 ml water and adjust pH to 6.5 with KOH.

full_parsed_frozen_recipe.name: Medium for haloalkaliphilic methanogen

ingredients.preferred_term: Sodium dithionite solution in 1 M NaHCO3
ingredients.notes: NBRC Medium 1356 adds one drop of filter-sterile 10% sodium dithionite solution in 1 M NaHCO3 by syringe.

preparation_steps.description: Mix Mineral base 1 ingredients and autoclave under an N2 atmosphere; after 1 day, use only the supernatant. Final pH should be 10.
Mix Mineral base 2 ingredients and autoclave under an N2 atmosphere. Final pH should be 7.3.
For the trace elements solution, first dissolve NTA, adjust pH to 6.5 with NaOH, then add minerals; final pH is 7.0.
Prepare the FeS slurry from 0.5 M FeSO4·7H2O and 0.5 M Na2S·9H2O, wash with pure water, resuspend the FeS precipitate as a 20% solution, and autoclave at 110 C for 30 min under N2.
Mix Mineral base 1 and Mineral base 2 in a 1:1 proportion in tightly closed vessels under an N2 atmosphere.
Separately autoclave concentrated Bacto Yeast Extract, coenzyme M, sodium acetate, Na2S·9H2O, and FeS slurry under an N2 atmosphere in tightly closed vessels.
Filter-sterilize concentrated MgCl2·6H2O, vitamin solution, trace element solution, methanol, and sodium formate solution.
After re-exchanging with N2, add one drop of filter-sterile 10% sodium dithionite in 1 M NaHCO3 by syringe. Final pH of the complete medium should be 9.

NBRC lists Medium for haloalkaliphilic methanogen as a 1:1 mix of two N2-autoclaved mineral bases with MgCl2, Bacto Yeast Extract, coenzyme M, vitamin and trace-element stocks, methanol, formate, acetate, FeS slurry, Na2S, and a 10% sodium dithionite solution in 1 M NaHCO3.
